purpose: Independent practice of D2.1 complementary events.

header.character_watermark: Maybe Mae the Cat in the top-right corner with a clipboard. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Draw a line from each event to its complement.
parts.visual_layout: Two-column matching: 5 events on left, 5 complements on right (scrambled).

image_placeholders.description: A two-column matching layout for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Left: 5 events (HEADS, RAIN, WIN, EVEN, DAY). Right: 5 complements scrambled (NIGHT, ODD, NO RAIN, LOSE, TAILS). Wide gap for line-drawing.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P1_MATCH at Part 1: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Heads-Tails, Rain-No Rain, Win-Lose, Even-Odd, Day-Night.

parts.student_instructions: Sort 6 pairs as COMPLEMENTARY or NOT.
parts.visual_layout: 6 pair rows with checkboxes for COMP / NOT.

image_placeholders.description: Six pair rows for a Grade 2 worksheet, B&W line art. Each row has a pair (e.g., 'Hot or Cold', 'Heads or Tails', 'Big or Small', 'Even or Odd', 'Happy or Sad', 'Pass or Fail') and two checkboxes COMP / NOT.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P2_SORT at Part 2: keywords name the activity.

parts.answer_key: Hot/Cold = NOT (warm in between). Heads/Tails = COMP. Big/Small = NOT (medium in between). Even/Odd = COMP. Happy/Sad = NOT (neutral in between). Pass/Fail = COMP.

parts.student_instructions: Write 3 of your own complement pairs.

image_placeholders.description: Three lines for a Grade 2 worksheet. Each: 'Either ___ or ___'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS02_P3_LINES at Part 3: keywords name the activity.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find a NOT-strictly-complementary pair and explain.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 consolidation. Use Part 2 for formative — children spotting non-complement pairs (warm in between).
